reference_sql:
WITH monthly_spend AS (  -- one row per channel and month with ad spend from July to October 2025
  SELECT c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend_eur
  FROM ad_spend_daily a
  JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  WHERE a.spend_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-31'
  GROUP BY c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE)
),
budget_months AS (  -- one row per channel and month in budget_monthly from July to October 2025
  SELECT ch.channel_name, b.month, b.budget_eur, COALESCE(m.spend_eur, 0) AS spend_eur
  FROM budget_monthly b
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = b.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN monthly_spend m ON m.channel_id = b.channel_id AND m.month = b.month
  WHERE b.month BETWEEN DATE '2025-07-01' AND DATE '2025-10-01'
),
running AS (  -- one row per channel and month, with the totals since July 2025
  SELECT channel_name, month, spend_eur,
         SUM(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name ORDER BY month
                              ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS spend_to_date_eur,
         SUM(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name ORDER BY month
                               ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS budget_to_date_eur
  FROM budget_months
)
SELECT channel_name, month, spend_eur, spend_to_date_eur, budget_to_date_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * spend_to_date_eur / NULLIF(budget_to_date_eur, 0), 1) AS pacing_pct
FROM running
ORDER BY channel_name, month

WITH budget_months AS (  -- one row per channel and month in budget_monthly from July to October 2025, with its spend
  SELECT ch.channel_name, b.month, b.budget_eur,
         (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(a.spend), 0)
            FROM ad_spend_daily a
            JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
           WHERE c.channel_id = b.channel_id
             AND a.spend_date >= b.month
             AND a.spend_date < b.month + INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS spend_eur
  FROM budget_monthly b
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = b.channel_id
  WHERE b.month >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND b.month <= DATE '2025-10-01'
)
SELECT channel_name, month, spend_eur,
       SUM(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS spend_to_date_eur,
       SUM(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS budget_to_date_eur,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(spend_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW)
             / NULLIF(SUM(budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY channel_name ORDER BY month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW), 0), 1) AS pacing_pct
FROM budget_months
ORDER BY 1, 2

WITH budget_months AS (  -- one row per channel and month in budget_monthly from July to October 2025
  SELECT b.channel_id, ch.channel_name, b.month, b.budget_eur
  FROM budget_monthly b
  JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = b.channel_id
  WHERE b.month BETWEEN '2025-07-01' AND '2025-10-01'
),
with_spend AS (  -- one row per channel and month, with the month's spend (0 when there was none)
  SELECT bm.channel_id, bm.channel_name, bm.month, bm.budget_eur, COALESCE(SUM(a.spend), 0) AS spend_eur
  FROM budget_months bm
  LEFT JOIN campaigns c ON c.channel_id = bm.channel_id
  LEFT JOIN ad_spend_daily a
    ON a.campaign_id = c.campaign_id
   AND CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) = bm.month
  GROUP BY bm.channel_id, bm.channel_name, bm.month, bm.budget_eur
),
to_date AS (  -- one row per channel and month: the months of the same channel up to and including it, added up
  SELECT x.channel_name, x.month, x.spend_eur, SUM(y.spend_eur) AS spend_to_date_eur, SUM(y.budget_eur) AS budget_to_date_eur
  FROM with_spend x
  JOIN with_spend y ON y.channel_id = x.channel_id AND y.month <= x.month
  GROUP BY x.channel_name, x.month, x.spend_eur
)
SELECT channel_name, month, spend_eur, spend_to_date_eur, budget_to_date_eur,
       ROUND(spend_to_date_eur * 100.0 / NULLIF(budget_to_date_eur, 0), 1) AS pacing_pct
FROM to_date
ORDER BY channel_name ASC, month ASC

solver.query:
WITH b AS (
  SELECT b.channel_id, ch.channel_name, b.month, b.budget_eur
  FROM budget_monthly b JOIN channels ch ON ch.channel_id = b.channel_id
  WHERE b.month >= DATE '2025-07-01' AND b.month <= DATE '2025-10-01'
), sp AS (
  SELECT c.channel_id, CAST(date_trunc('month', a.spend_date) AS DATE) AS month, SUM(a.spend) AS spend
  FROM ad_spend_daily a JOIN campaigns c ON c.campaign_id = a.campaign_id
  GROUP BY 1, 2
), m AS (
  SELECT b.channel_name, b.month, COALESCE(sp.spend, 0) AS spend_eur, b.budget_eur,
         SUM(COALESCE(sp.spend, 0)) OVER (PARTITION BY b.channel_id ORDER BY b.month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS spend_to_date_eur,
         SUM(b.budget_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY b.channel_id ORDER BY b.month ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS budget_to_date_eur
  FROM b LEFT JOIN sp ON sp.channel_id = b.channel_id AND sp.month = b.month
)
SELECT channel_name, month, spend_eur, spend_to_date_eur, budget_to_date_eur,
       CASE WHEN budget_to_date_eur = 0 THEN NULL ELSE ROUND(100.0 * spend_to_date_eur / budget_to_date_eur, 1) END AS pacing_pct
FROM m
ORDER BY channel_name ASC, month ASC
